title: Best private tour on Gaudi and his works
text: If you are looking for the backstory of Gaudi and see his main designed homes this is your tour with Patrick! We walked to the main homes then travel by metro to La Sagrada Familia. Along the way took breaks to rest if needed.
author: Leslie S

title: The most enriching of tours!
text:
Patrick was such an engaging guide! His knowledge of the history of Barcelona’s old town truly brought the city to life. We took pauses to reflect on the times, and what the city may have looked like back then to really ground the wonder of the buildings we looked at. His storytelling was vivid and immersive—it felt like stepping back in time.

title: In search of an enriching & memorable tour? Don’t hesitate, book with Patrick
text:
Patrick’s Gaudi & Modernism tour (booked as a private tour) was a highlight of my family’s trip to Spain that spanned multiple Andalusia stops and Barcelona. Patrick is an enthralling storyteller who held our attention, including those of my 11-year-old and 14-year-old boys, with ease.  His tour was both informative and entertaining, and also reasonably priced, especially for a group of four.  In fact, Patrick’s tour of Sagrada Familia (external only) was significantly better than the official guided tour of Sagrada Familia that we experienced the following day.

title: Dragons!
text: Patrick is quite a storyteller. He was an incredible guide on our tour of Paseo de Gracia in Barcelona! He shared stories about the stunning buildings and their rich history, keeping us captivated throughout. I don't want to spoil too much about the tour but as Patrick will say: "Dragons, dragons everywhere". Highly recommend, thanks Patrick, this will last as one of our memories from Barcelona. Charles & Caline

title: More Than Just a Tour: Patrick’s Passion for Gaudí and Modernism Shines Through
text: Patrick's tour was one of the best ones I've joined in my years of travelling around Europe. He shared Gaudi and the Modernism architecture with such captivating emotions and stories that will transport you back into those days. I especially love the details he shared about the design inspirations and backgrounds of the families from those houses. They make the already magical houses become even more alive. On a side note, Patrick normally operates in small groups only so you can ask lots of questions and hear information more clearly, especially in the hustle of Passeig de Gracia. Throughout
author: 287mingm

title: Great Tour with an Excellent Guide
text: We throughly enjoyed the tour with Patrick, he was a knowledgeable guide and offered a great tour that explored the complexities of architecture during the 19th century and the influence of Gaudi on Barcelona. Patrick was a great storyteller and was able to deliver lots of interesting information over the course of the tour. Would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: adamgD4415EC

title: Patrick is a great storyteller!
text: We have visited Barcelona for the 3rd time and visited one of the Gaudi designed houses before but the tour was full of information we did not know. Patrick does a good build up for the tour and also shares some interesting Catalan story related to the buildings you'll see. It's not a long walk and definitely interesting, much recommended!
author: julesnijs

title: Absolutely a must!!!!
text:
We did the Gaudi and Modernism tour with Patrick; it was simply fascinating! Native English speaking, full of life guide ,bring's a lot of fun and jokes in the whole tour. It was like a great rock concert, as we were going it just kept getting better and better! Patrick also helped us a lot giving extra tips how to use the public transportation sistem. He was very pasionate, you can see that he loves what he's doing.

I highly recommend it!
